teaser.en: A wild grape vine the Digo know by its stem rather than its leaves.
teaser.sw: Mzabibu pori ambao Wadigo huutambua kwa shina lake badala ya majani.
teaser.dg: Mzabibu wa weruni ambao Adigo anaumanya kpwa muhiwe, si kpwa makodzage.

summary.en: Mwamchitophyo is an unidentified Cissus, a wild climber of the grape family. Pakia records that the Digo recognise it by its stem.
summary.sw: Mwamchitophyo ni Cissus ambayo spishi yake haijatambuliwa, mmea pori unaotambaa wa familia ya mizabibu. Pakia anaripoti kwamba Wadigo huutambua kwa shina lake.
summary.dg: Mwamchitophyo ni Cissus ambayo ainaye taidzangbwemanyikana, libugu ra weruni ra jamii ya mzabibu. Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo anaumanya kpwa muhiwe.

about.en: Pakia identified Mwamchitophyo only to genus, as a species of Cissus, a climber of the grape family. Cissus vines climb with tendrils that grow opposite the leaves, and many coastal species have fleshy, angled or winged stems. The flowers are tiny and greenish, followed by small berries. The Digo identify this one by its stem.
about.sw: Pakia aliutambua Mwamchitophyo hadi kiwango cha jenasi tu, kama spishi ya Cissus, mmea unaotambaa wa familia ya mizabibu. Mimea ya Cissus hupanda kwa kutumia vikonyo vinavyoota upande wa pili wa majani, na spishi nyingi za pwani zina mashina yenye majimaji, yenye pembe au mabawa. Maua ni madogo sana na ya rangi ya kijani-kijani, yakifuatwa na matunda madogo ya beri. Wadigo huutambua huu kwa shina lake.
about.dg: Pakia waumanya Mwamchitophyo hadi jenasi tu, dza aina ya Cissus, libugu ra jamii ya mzabibu. Mbugu za Cissus zinadzilinga-linga dzulu kpwa nyuzi zinazomera zichilolana na makodza, na aina nyinji za pwani zina mihi inayonona, yenye pembe au yenye mapha. Maruwa ni madide sana na ga chijani ngushu-ngushu, na badaye kunatuluka matunda madide. Adigo anaumanya uhu kpwa muhiwe.

where.en: Pakia does not record where it grows. Cissus vines on the coast climb through bushland, thicket and forest edges.
where.sw: Pakia haripoti mahali unapoota. Mimea ya Cissus ya pwani hupanda katikati ya vichaka, vichaka vizito na pembezoni mwa misitu.
where.dg: Pakia kaandika phatu unaphomera. Pwani, mbugu za Cissus zinadzilinga-linga weruni, vitsakani na kanda-kanda ya matsaka.

culture.en: Pakia notes that Cissus species are among the few plants the Digo cannot tell apart by their leaves alone, so they look at the stem instead.
culture.sw: Pakia anabainisha kwamba spishi za Cissus ni miongoni mwa mimea michache ambayo Wadigo hawawezi kuitofautisha kwa majani pekee, kwa hiyo huangalia shina badala yake.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala aina za Cissus ni kahi ya mimea michache ambayo Adigo taaweza kumanya tafwauti kahi yao kpwa kulola makodza tu, kpwa hivyo analola muhi badalaye.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mwamchitophyo but gives no meaning or shared names. Its scientific name is Cissus sp.; the species was not determined.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti jina la Kidigo Mwamchitophyo lakini hatoi maana yake wala majina ya pamoja na lugha nyingine. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Cissus sp.; spishi yake haikubainishwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo Mwamchitophyo, ela kalavya manage wala madzina ga luga zanjina. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni Cissus sp.; ainaye hasa taidzangbwemanyikana.

reason.en: Another Cissus, known by its brittle stem
reason.sw: Cissus nyingine, inayotambulika kwa shina lake linalokatika kwa urahisi
reason.dg: Cissus yanjina, inayomanyikana kpwa muhiwe unaodoka upesi

reason.en: Another climber of the grape family
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine unaotambaa wa familia ya mizabibu
reason.dg: Libugu ranjina ra jamii ya mzabibu
